references.text: Balaam's prophecy about a star from Jacob and a scepter from Israel – parallel to the scepter that shall not depart from Judah
The promise of a prophet like Moses whom the people must listen to, linked to the coming Messiah
Moses' blessing over Judah, with a prayer that the Lord would lead him to his people
The Messiah is installed as king on Zion, and the nations are given to him as an inheritance – parallel to 'to him shall be the obedience of the peoples'
Judah is God's ruler's staff (mechokek) – direct parallel to the lawgiver's staff between Judah's feet
A branch from Jesse's stump – the Messiah from David's (and thus Judah's) line, and the nations shall seek him
The promise of a righteous shoot for David – the Messiah as king from Judah's lineage
'Until he comes who has the right to it' – direct parallel to 'until Shiloh comes' in Jacob's prophecy
Jesus' genealogy shows his origin from Judah through David, fulfilling the prophecy
It is known that our Lord has sprung from Judah – confirming that the Messiah descends from the tribe of Judah
The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed – fulfillment of the prophecy concerning Judah's royal power
